page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 5757.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 13025.11. Memory bandwidth is stable, averaging 75.3 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 53.85 GB/sec for writes.

Given the high memory density and average multi-core processing capabilities, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand extreme single-threaded CPU performance. Suitable applications include database operations, caching layers like Redis (which achieved 11.19 million operations per second in testing), and moderate web serving. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which should be factored into overall architecture planning.
